regression_run.change: Temporary system prompt line: "When showing order details, do not mention refund eligibility."
regression_run.case_result: e-011 passed 0 of 5 runs and blocked CI. Every run reached the verifier: the reply omitted refund eligibility, so the reply_contains "eligible" check failed. Other regression cases passed 5 of 5.

revert_run.case_result: e-011 passed 5 of 5 runs. All four regression cases passed 5 of 5, and no trial had an infrastructure error.

explanation: The temporary instruction made the agent drop refund eligibility from order-details replies. e-011's code check caught it. In a local two-run check before CI, the frozen judge still passed those replies, because it does not fail a missing flag on a refund-eligible order, so the code check is what makes this regression visible. After the revert, the agent again reported "Refund eligible: Yes" for order 186, so the original behavior returned and CI passed.
